title: Academic Support - RBC Royal Bank Supported After School Programs
description: Helping kids Succeed - 89% of parents surveyed report that their kids are doing better in school as a result of their participation in United Way-funded After School Programs

asr.full_text: My name is Stacy Wiseman . I am the child and youth worker and the program manager of July Learn Place This program is very important because the children around here especially for homework. A lot of the families around here, they're all low income, a lot of them don't have education background, so to give their children the homework help that they need to carry on, to go to high school, college, and so on, they can't give it to them. So what we do here is the main focus. When they're here, they get the homework help from myself, my assistant Jessica, and three Gino staff, Alissa, Bret, and Samantha. We also have volunteers here that also help with the homework. my assistant Jessica and three Gino staff Elissa Brett, Samantha. So we also have volunteers here that also help with the homework. I have seen a lot of changes and some of the kids it's kind of funny when they get the report cards I'm the first one to see them. They come in right after school, I got my report card they hand me the report card and I check it I look at it, I'm like wow amazing from the first day that I started, grades have gone up. We have had a couple that kinda straggle, but we practice. In a big house today, there should be another Ziploc wall of legs.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents RBC-supported after-school programs and United Way-funded programming in an educational and public-service context. The described activity involves children receiving homework help from staff and volunteers, with reported educational improvements rather than requests for money, credentials, investment, or participation in a deceptive transaction. The branding provides organizational context, while the described material does not show a scam-like solicitation flow directed at viewers.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The primary content is an educational and operational depiction of an after-school program, including staff-provided homework help and children engaged in classroom activities.
